STEP 2 - Vessel size:

b) Reference cue: the apple is about 8 cm across. The plate spans roughly 2.7 to 2.9 apple widths across the frame, which gives about 22-23 cm.
Reconciled width: 22 cm. Area = 0.785 x 22^2 = 380 cm2.

- Carrot (cut sticks/chunks): covers roughly 15% of the plate area, about 57 cm2. Average thickness about 1.5 cm (one piece deep, moderately stacked), so volume about 85 ml x 0.6 = 51 g. Carrot is about 35 kcal/100 g (cooked weight).
- Cauliflower florets: cover roughly 18% of the plate area, about 68 cm2. Mounded, average thickness about 2 cm, so volume about 136 ml x 0.6 = 82 g. Cauliflower is about 25 kcal/100 g.

Hidden food: no base layer is visible under the items. The almond pile is the only stacked element and is already counted.

- Almonds: 72 g x 5.8 = 418 kcal
- Apple: 150 g x 0.52 = 78 kcal
- Carrot: 51 g x 0.35 = 18 kcal
- Cauliflower: 82 g x 0.25 = 21 kcal
